_readme: Where Decks Find You (/shops/). To add a shop, add one entry to "shops" with the same fields, then run: python3 scripts/build_shops.py. Region must match a name in "regions". Leave website as "" when there isn't one. Shops are sorted by town inside each region automatically.

regions.name: Northern Territory
regions.note: We're still looking for a shop in Alice Springs.

shops.name: Crow and Cauldron
shops.description: Violet's witch shop in Sydney's south, stocking tarot cards and spell supplies. She reads and teaches there too.

shops.name: The Cauldron of Wellbeing
shops.address: Shop 7–9, Parker Arcade, 476 High St, Penrith NSW
shops.description: Lynne's witchcraft and Pagan shop at the back of Parker Arcade, with a large range of tarot and oracle cards. Free parking across the road.

shops.name: Kiki The Hippie Shop
shops.description: A colourful shop between the post office and the bakery, with tarot and oracle cards, crystals, handmade jewellery and upcycled clothing.

shops.name: Soulife
shops.description: Tarot and oracle cards, crystals, second-hand books and records on Jonson Street.

shops.name: Temple of the Divine
shops.description: Jocelyne turned the hair salon where she trained as a teenager into a witch shop. Ask about the unopened vintage tarot decks.

shops.name: The Empress & Wolf
shops.description: Elicia's shop began as a gallery. Tarot, oracle and Lenormand decks downstairs, and readers in the rooms upstairs.

shops.name: Phoenix Alternative Body & Soul
shops.description: A crystal shop in the Bridge Mall with tarot cards and its own oils, and an upstairs studio for sound baths and Reiki classes.

shops.name: Tarotopia
shops.days: Tuesday to Saturday, and the second and fourth Sunday
shops.description: Rebecca's shop is all about cards, with more than 2,500 tarot and oracle products. She reads in store too.

shops.name: Gypsy Moon
shops.description: Kim's family-run shop carries more than 180 tarot decks and 240 oracle decks, beside her own dreamcatchers and mandalas.

shops.name: Crystal Ball Bookstore
shops.description: An independent Cairns bookstore since 1988, a few steps from Rusty's Markets, with a tarot reader in store every day.

shops.name: Enchanted Margaret River
shops.description: A faery-themed shop on the main street with tarot and oracle cards and books on divination.

shops.name: Boodi Crystals
shops.description: A crystal and mineral shop in South Bunbury with a shelf of tarot and oracle decks.

shops.name: Eternal Spirit
shops.description: Open since 1997 and now in Yasmine's care, with tarot, oracle and Lenormand decks and a blog on choosing one.

shops.name: Spellbound Magical Gifts
shops.description: Family run and on Murray Street since 2001 (it began as Fairy Secrets). Book a reading, or bring the kids to Saturday story time.

shops.name: Sacred Sage Emporium
shops.description: Tarot and crystals beside goods from local makers, on Strathalbyn's High Street.

shops.name: The Page and Cup
shops.description: Lynn's shop of tarot and oracle decks from around the world, with new and used books and Tasmanian herbal teas. Bring time.

shops.name: Just Magic
shops.description: An ethical clothing and gift shop on Charles Street that keeps tarot cards beside its crystals and spiritual books.

shops.name: The Crystal Chalice
shops.address: Shop 66, Ori Building, 30 Lonsdale St, Braddon ACT
shops.description: Lilitu has run this Pagan shop since 2004, with tarot and oracle decks and readings by booking.

shops.name: Spiritual Dreaming
shops.description: Two doors from the Coolalinga Post Office, with tarot and oracle cards among the crystals. It posts Australia-wide.

shops.name: The Woo-Woo Shop
shops.days: Visits by appointment, ships across New Zealand
shops.description: Denita opened the shop in 2017 for new and pre-loved decks, and runs a yearly Introduction to Tarot workshop. She'll also take the decks you've finished with.

shops.name: Mystic Journey
shops.description: Sally and Tim's crystal shop, open since 2016, with tarot and oracle cards and books alongside.
